_comments: Sample configuration for IBM DB2 (Db2 for LUW). Verified end-to-end.
KNOWN LIMITATION: five DB2-specific JDBC connection properties added in JDX 05.26
cannot currently be passed through jdbc_url -- the DB2 driver (jcc) requires a
';'-terminated property block, but JDX uses ';' as its own JDX_DATABASE field
separator, so the terminator doesn't survive. Core reverse-engineering, REST
packaging, and CRUD operations are unaffected. No workaround yet; tracked as a
db_schema: set to the schema name (typically the username or a named schema).
Download the DB2 JDBC driver from Maven Central: com.ibm.db2:jcc
(the jar is versioned e.g. jcc-12.1.5.0.jar; the old db2jcc4.jar filename is out of date).
Copy to your project root, rename to orm_skyway_config.json, and edit for your database.
